integrity: All general statements follow from a direct stratification and uniqueness argument. The accompanying exhaustive finite checks are corroborating evidence and not exhaustive over all fields or quivers.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the reduced pairwise-zero-product tuple variety in the finite-dimensional algebra of a quiver modulo the square of the arrow ideal. Only top-dimensional components are counted; the nonreduced scheme and lower-dimensional components are not classified. Polynomial recovery does not imply graph isomorphism. Historical publication priority is not independently certified.
title: Pairwise-annihilating tuple varieties of radical-square-zero quiver algebras
